PawnKindDef.label: Asuran operative
PawnKindDef.description: A human-form Asuran combat and recovery operative built from a coordinated nanite lattice. This is an ordinary Lattice combat role, not sovereign Queen authority.

PawnKindDef.label: Asuran technician
PawnKindDef.description: An Asuran technical specialist used for nanite engineering, recovery operations and Ancient-derived systems.

PawnKindDef.label: Asuran commander
PawnKindDef.description: A senior Asuran field commander coordinating Lattice operations. Command rank is not the same as the unique Replicator Queen's sovereign block-Replicator authority.
